name: Deadly Vectors
summary: In your opponent's Command phase, roll 2D6 for each Afflicted enemy unit (-1 if it's Below Half-strength): on 6 or less, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

name: Worldblight
summary: At the end of your Command phase, an objective a Death Guard unit controls becomes secured. While an enemy unit is within range of that objective, it is Afflicted.
